body.summary: A hacker called Neo, who has spent years sensing that something is wrong with the world, is drawn out of his ordinary life by Trinity and Morpheus and offered a choice between a red pill and a blue pill. He wakes in a pod aboard the hovercraft Nebuchadnezzar and learns that the world he knew is a simulation the machines built to farm human bodies, and that the resistance believes he is the One prophesied to end the war. When the traitor Cypher sells Morpheus to the Agents, Neo goes back into the Matrix to rescue him, is shot dead by Agent Smith, and is revived by Trinity's confession of love; he then sees the code for what it is and destroys Smith from the inside. The film ends with Neo on a phone call, promising to show the people a world without rules, then flying off.

arcs.summary: Neo is contacted, tested and freed, then trained in the Construct until he can fight and begins to suspect he is not the One.
The Oracle's prophecy sets up a choice between Morpheus's life and Neo's own; Cypher's betrayal forces it.
Neo and Trinity storm the building to rescue Morpheus, and Neo's belief lets him outrun and then destroy Agent Smith.

notable_scenes.summary: Trinity escapes two Agents across rooftops and vanishes into a phone booth.
Morpheus offers the red and blue pills in a bare room.
Neo wakes in a pod, is flushed out, and sees the fields of humans for the first time.
The child bends the spoon and tells Neo there is no spoon.
The Oracle tells Neo he is not the One and that he will have to choose between his life and Morpheus's.
Cypher pulls the plugs on Apoc and Switch and taunts Trinity before Tank shoots him.
Neo and Trinity shoot their way through the lobby and Neo lifts Morpheus onto a helicopter.
Neo dodges bullets on the rooftop and is shot dead by Smith, then revived by Trinity's kiss.
Neo sees the code, dives into Smith and destroys him from within.
Neo hangs up the phone and flies over the city.
